means: The main context line of a session; during a stem it holds only the stem's handle and step lines.
A branch (git plus context) taken at the goal's turn; work runs there and folds back to the core line.
The turn where a stem branches; a cache checkpoint can sit there (stem anchor).
The stem's result re-pointed into the core line's handle once the stem finishes.
An opaque id whose bytes stay fixed in the cached prefix while what it resolves to changes.
Change what a handle resolves to in the store without editing the context bytes.
Read what a handle currently holds, with the read tool the model already uses.
Model asks for what it needs by handle, instead of the harness pushing a narrative.
A cache breakpoint chosen where it pays: system, tail or stem anchor kind.
A named versioned spec the turn loop reads at fixed seams, id strat-<name>-<major>.<minor>.
A module boundary where behavior plugs in: tools, providers, strategies, hooks, policies, handles, checkpoints, machine, coord.
A small model that checks each completed tool call and answers ok or FLAG with a reason.
A watcher note on a tool call, stored on the session (s.flags) and counted as a smell.
An operator's assessment of a session against its goal, stored as s.watched.
A Claude Code session that drives harness sessions through scripts/wh.mjs and reports what it cannot resolve.
A point before each model request or tool call where a session can be held.
State of a session waiting at a gate until step or resume.
One lockstep advance: every waiting session takes one step and holds again.
Stop every tab at its next gate; used for lockstep and for updates.
A turn spent to inspect a wait point; a passing check needs no wake.
Re-pointing what handles resolve to so a stem's downstream turns see altered or materialized context.
Write real turn content into the context where a handle stood.
The component that decides what a handle resolves to; the micro resolver is a small model doing so at the leading edge.
Models consult at checkpoints: A ahead, B look-back, plus a consult; arranged as a graph.
A generic prompt turn with a throwaway reply that registers the cache for a byte-stable payload.
A tracked issue (labels concern, kind:*, ci-failure, triaged, needs-*) worked in the background loop.
A recorded oddity (wh:smells: kind, tool, detail, steer fingerprint) tracked over time.
The generic points and directions given to a session; logged in the log repo.
Per-turn session rows: prompt, cached, cacheWrite, completion, reasoning, cost, bp kinds, strat id, upstream.
A live value drawn by CSS from data-v via slot(el, value); changes without re-rendering.
A named CSS rule via rule(name, css); UI state is a rule, not a node edit.
Checks written from the goal and committed red before the implementation.
A check fails (red) before implementation and passes (green) after.
A measured comparison against plain serial turns, run with scripts/casestudy.mjs.
The baseline: plain serial turns without stems; results are reported relative to it.
The provider route behind a model on OpenRouter; stems inherit the core's upstream so the cache holds.
The shared in-browser VM and its host, with per-session unix users.
A set of sessions sharing a profile (settings such as strategy and watchModel).
A redaction handle form: what it resolves to is hidden from the model.
